_image_reference_note: Pinned to the app version TAG, not a digest (#2110 Teil 4): the reference is committed in the release commit, BEFORE publish-image.yml pushes - the digest does not exist yet at commit time, the tag is deterministic. Tags are pushed once per release and never moved; the digest is recorded by the publish run's summary and the release notes. The tag's version segment is rewritten by make sync-versions (same class as app_version), so it cannot drift from backend/pyproject.toml.
_container_volumes_note: The PREFIXED name is deliberate (#2154), not a typo to tidy up. Compose prefixes volume names with the project name, so the compose path created adaptive-learner_adaptive-learner-data and the user's database, uploads and Fernet secret.key live there. docker-py takes container_volumes literally, so declaring the bare name would mount a DIFFERENT, empty volume and the app would look freshly installed while the data sat invisible next to it. The name carries a compose artifact forever; that is the price of finding existing data without asking the user to act.
